handleDecodeResult(frameIndex: number, result: DecodedFrameResult, error?: string): void {\n494\t    const frameTimestamp = this.frameTimestamps.get(frameIndex);\n495\t    if (frameTimestamp === decodeMs,\n535\t        ...(error !== undefined ? { error } : {}),\n536\t      };\n537\t      this.onFrameResult(frameResult);\n538\t    }\n539\t  }\n540\t\n541\t  /**\n542\t   * Handle a pipeline  }\n549\t  }\n550\t\n551\t  /**\n552\t   * Update performance metrics (called periodically).\n553\t   */\n554\t  private updateMetrics(): void {\n555\t    const now = performance.now();\n556\t    const elapsed = now - this.lastFpsUpdate;\n557\t\n558\t    if (elapsed < 1000) {\n559\t      return; // Update every second\n560\t    }\n561\t\n562\t    // Calculate capture FPS\n563\t Math.floor(sortedLatencies.length * 0.99);\n588\t    const avgLatency = sortedLatencies.length > 0\n589\t      ? sortedLatencies.reduce((sum, lat) => sum + lat, 0) / sortedLatencies.length\n590\t      : 0;\n591\t\n592\t    return {\n593\t      captureFps: this.currentCaptureFps,\n594\t      decodeFps: this.currentDecodeFps,\n595\t      packetsPerSec: this.currentPacketsPerSec,\n596\t totalFrames: this.frameCount,\n601\t      totalDecoded: this.decodedCount,\n602\t      poolUtilization: this.decodePool ? this.decodePool.getStats().utilization : 0,\n603\t    };\n604\t  }\n605\t\n606\t  /**\n607\t   * Set the frame result callback.\n608\t   */\n609\t  setFrameResultCallback(callback: FrameResultCallback): void {\n610\t    this.onFrameResult = callback;\n611\t
